title: 166b2691/I1: Pin criterion baselines for all targeted kernels
description:
Run `cargo bench -p gf2-core --bench <kernel-bench> -- --save-baseline ppc-v0-2026-04-25` for every bench listed below and commit a JSON manifest at `dev/benchmarks/ppc-baselines.json` mapping each kernel ID (A1..D2) to its baseline name and the commit hash measured at.

## Benches to baseline

- `matrix_vector` — A1
- `matmul` — A2, B3
- `fp_specialized` + `fieldvec_dot_product` — A3, C3, C4, C5
- `gf2m_mul_strategies`, `gf2m_wide_mul` — C1, C2
- `m4rm_components`, `m4rm_profile` — B2, B3
- `sparse` — D1, D2
- (transpose has no dedicated bench yet → B1 task creates one before its first edit)

## Success criteria

- [hard] `dev/benchmarks/ppc-baselines.json` exists, valid JSON, contains an entry for every Tier A–D kernel ID with `baseline_name`, `commit_hash`, and `bench_target`.
- [hard] All baselines actually exist under `target/criterion/<benchmark>/<baseline-name>/`.
- [hard] Re-running `cargo bench -p gf2-core --bench <bench> -- --baseline ppc-v0-2026-04-25` succeeds without modification.
